questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Vietnam?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Vietnam article.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Vietnam?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “History” part of the Vietnam article.

questions.proof: The kings of Champa (Chiêm Thành in Vietnamese) started construction of Hindu temples at Mỹ Sơn in the 4th century AD.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “The neighboring countries are _____, China, and Laos.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “China”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Vietnam article.

questions.proof: The neighboring countries are Cambodia, China, and Laos.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Media said in _____ that investment in science and technology was 2% of GDP.”

hints.nudge: It is a year in the twenty-first century.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Science and technology” part of the Vietnam article.

questions.proof: Media said in 2011 that investment in science and technology was 2% of GDP.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “_____ desired trading freedom in Vietnam.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “desired”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: It is further down the Vietnam article, under the heading “History”.

questions.proof: France desired trading freedom in Vietnam.
